title: Architect Review — WC01–WC15 Ordered Sequence Release Readiness

overallDecision.reason: The local workspace designs are generally sound, but the sequence lacks shared resolver, handoff-participation, source-freshness, candidate-state, workspace-migration, and baseline contracts required for coherent end-to-end execution.

acceptedArchitectureBoundaries: One nested Project, Phase, and Work Card lifecycle
Intake, Planning, Building, Validation, and Close at each level
Durable repository documents remain visible workflow evidence
No hidden workflow authority, route tokens, role gates, execution runs, approval queues, or hashes
Project and Phase planning bundles use synchronized dispositions
The Approved Formal Work Card is the Implementer instruction
Implementer Report review occurs before Operator validation
Validation Records are created only after Operator validation
Repairs remain bounded siblings of the original Work Card
Phase and Project Close use one closeout decision without duplicate approval artifacts

blockingFindings.title: No evidence-derived lifecycle and workspace resolver
blockingFindings.problem: WC01 establishes vocabulary and registry structure, but no card replaces the current flat first-non-approved resolver with a nested lifecycle and workspace projection that understands semantic completion and parent-child returns.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: Add a bounded foundation card after WC01 for document participation roles, document-to-workspace ownership, evidence-derived lifecycle location, selected phase and Work Card identity, semantic close predicates, deterministic workspace order, direct navigation targets, and plain-language current-location evidence without persisted hidden state.
blockingFindings.recommendedCardTitle: Evidence-Derived Lifecycle Projection and Workspace Resolution

blockingFindings.title: Generated handoff documents can trap the resolver
blockingFindings.problem: Generated prompt and handoff pairs have no shared non-review participation rule. WC09 explicitly leaves its handoff Pending, but WC10 has no action that can disposition it, creating a deterministic deadlock under the current resolver.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: Define one shared non-review handoff contract. The recommended rule is that successfully generated system handoffs are viewable and regenerable but use Document.Status=Approved and are not independent review gates. An alternative explicit non-gating participation model must be visible and deterministic.

blockingFindings.title: No source freshness or downstream invalidation contract
blockingFindings.problem: Approved upstream documents can be revised while stale downstream planning, implementation, report, validation, and close evidence remains Approved.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: Define monotonic non-hash artifact revision identity, source-revision references, deterministic freshness checks, coordinated downstream invalidation or Pending reset rules, repair and validation precedence, and plain-language stale-source diagnostics. Timestamps and filesystem order must not be authority.

blockingFindings.title: Work Card candidate state is undefined
blockingFindings.problem: The sequence relies on deferred, superseded, already-satisfied, carried-forward, resolved, and completed candidate states without defining a canonical schema, evidence contract, or post-approval edit path.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: Define candidateId, order, title, purpose, dependsOn, resolutionStatus, resolutionReason, and evidencePaths. Recommended resolution values are planned, completed, deferred, superseded, alreadySatisfied, and carriedForward. Completed remains derived from Work Card evidence.

blockingFindings.title: Workspace inventory, stable IDs, ordering, and migration are incomplete
blockingFindings.problem: Several cards omit stable workspace IDs or relative order, provisional clean-room workspaces are not consistently migrated, and WC09 claims Work Card Intake without registering a Work Card Intake workspace.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: Publish a complete workspace inventory and migration table containing workspaceId, label, lifecycle level, lifecycle stage, order, replaced provisional workspace, and owning card. WC09 must implement a separate work-card-intake workspace or obtain explicit approval to combine it with Phase Building.

blockingFindings.title: Phase Map stores a derived completion indicator
blockingFindings.problem: WC06 requires the Phase Map to contain whether Approved Phase Close evidence exists even though phase completion is supposed to be derived from current closeout documents.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: Persist phase identity, order, purpose, and dependencies only. Compute completion at read time from current Phase_Closeout evidence.

blockingFindings.title: WC12 requires a post-validation path before WC13 exists
blockingFindings.problem: WC12 acceptance language expects post-validation repair behavior before WC13 implements the production Validation Record workflow.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: WC12 must fully prove the pre-validation repair production path and may unit-test the post-validation trigger contract. WC13 must prove the real validation failure to repair to new validation attempt integration.

blockingFindings.title: No protected clean-room Git baseline
blockingFindings.problem: The large dirty working tree prevents reliable attribution of Phase 08 implementation changes and unrelated baseline drift.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: Before WC01 release, create an Operator-authorized reviewed baseline commit or an equivalent immutable snapshot and changed-path manifest. A clean baseline commit is recommended.

nonBlockingStandardizationCorrections: Use dependsOn as the JSON dependency field for every card; WC14 and WC15 currently use dependencies.
Add visible Depends on metadata to WC06 through WC15 Markdown headers.
Define canonical paths and disposition treatment for every generated Architect handoff.
State that newly created closeout documents begin as Pending.
Clarify that Architect report dispositions means the disposition on the Implementer Report, not a separate Architect Review artifact.
Define that a Rejected Formal Work Card returns to Phase Planning bundle revision.
Clarify that Approved DoNotClose remains current at Validation because close completion requires Approved plus Close.
Require every reused embedded-browser workspace to preserve the WC03 browser-security contract.

WC01.summary: Lifecycle vocabulary and registry scope are sound, but shared lifecycle resolution and source-freshness foundation cards must follow WC01.

WC02.summary: Add greenfield planning initialization, explicit intake and handoff disposition rules, canonical interview output path, and freshness behavior.

WC03.summary: Real embedded subscription and MCP proof is correctly isolated; mock success is prohibited.

WC04.summary: Dual-pane interview workspace is sound; add source-freshness handling and the corrected canonical output prompt contract.

WC05.summary: Synchronized Project Profile and Roadmap disposition is sound; add shared handoff participation and downstream invalidation.

WC06.summary: Remove persisted completion authority from Phase Map and define stable workspace ID and handoff contract.

WC07.summary: No-questions Phase Interview path is correct; add stable ID, handoff contract, and freshness rules.

WC08.summary: Define candidate schema and resolution states, migrate the provisional Phase Planning workspace, and add stable ID, handoff, and invalidation rules.

WC09.summary: Remove the Pending handoff deadlock, define the canonical handoff pair, and implement a registry-backed Work Card Intake workspace or explicitly rebaseline the model.

WC10.summary: Migrate the provisional Work Card workspace, define stable ID and rejected-card return path, and prevent stale reports or validation after Work Card revision.

WC11.summary: Work Card-as-handoff and report-disposition model are correct; add stable ID and order relative to repair workspace.

WC12.summary: Sibling repair model is accepted; split acceptance so WC12 proves pre-validation production flow and WC13 proves full post-validation integration.

WC13.summary: Validation-attempt and close-evidence model are correct; migrate Operator Validation, define stable Validation and Close IDs, and prove the real post-validation repair loop.

WC14.summary: One-closeout decision model is correct; migrate Phase Closeout and use semantic evidence-derived close resolution.

WC15.summary: Governed-corpus review and terminal close rules are sound, conditional on resolver, freshness, and metadata corrections.

recommendedSequenceRepairPlan: Add Evidence-Derived Lifecycle Projection and Workspace Resolution after WC01.
Add a shared Source Revision and Downstream Invalidation foundation contract or card.
Publish the complete stable workspace inventory and migration table.
Publish the canonical generated-handoff path and disposition contract.
Amend WC02 and WC04 through WC10 and WC14 for the shared contracts.
Amend WC08 and WC09 with the candidate schema and plan-revision behavior.
Amend WC12 and WC13 acceptance boundaries for post-validation repair integration.
Standardize all Markdown and JSON dependency metadata.
Conduct a second ordered Architect review before releasing WC01.
releaseReadinessCriteria: Evidence-derived lifecycle and workspace resolver is in the ordered sequence.
Non-review handoff artifacts cannot block progression.
Source freshness and downstream invalidation are defined.
Complete stable workspace inventory and migrations are explicit.
Work Card candidate states and revision behavior are defined.
Phase Map contains no persisted duplicate completion authority.
WC12 and WC13 acceptance boundaries are corrected.
All card dependencies and JSON fields are standardized.
A second ordered Architect review finds no blocking gap.
